physical.mounting-hardware: M6x12 screw x4, M6 cage nut x4

base.description: The shelf as FS ships FS-CFS-1U, with its M6 screws and cage nuts.

description: 1U 19in vented cantilever fixed shelf, FS FS-CFS-1U: a black SGCC steel tray 443.2 mm wide and 250.2 mm deep, its two side walls sloping from the full 44 mm at the front to the rear and folded out into ears that bolt to the front rails, with a low lip along the front edge. Fifteen diagonal vent slots in the floor; it carries 10 kg on 2- or 4-post racks.

gaps.note: no FS document states the shelf's own weight.

ears.description: the two mounting ears, the side walls folded out flat against the rails

shelf.description: the floor, its side walls and its rear lip

name: fs-cfs-1u

chassis.note: the specification gives 44.0 x 483.0 x 250.2 mm over the ears, which is the part: the ears are built in (provenance.ears). The drawing's top view dimensions the tray between them 17.45 in [443.2 mm].

color.note: black powder-coated steel, as every render shows.

ears.note: THE EARS ARE BUILT IN: each is the side wall's front end folded out flat, one piece with the tray and not removable (the datasheet's front view and the gallery render g1, SKU 71024), so under the owner's rule of 2026-10-09 they are part of the face and always drawn - 19.9 each side, the face the full 483.0, with their slots.

eia.note: EIA-310 hole positions: the rail holes of each rack unit stand 6.35, 22.225 and 38.1 mm up from its bottom, and the two rails' holes are 465.1 mm apart across the rack. The part is taken as centred in the rack units it fills.

hosting.note: the surface a device stands on is the floor between the two walls, 440.8 x 250.2 mm (the body less two 1.2 walls), recorded in `attrs.physical` as usable-width-mm and usable-depth-mm; the load is the datasheet's "Weight Capacity - Stationary" 10 kg. Hosting devices on it is #935's.

lifecycle.note: checked 2026-10-09 against what the intake holds: the FS documentation portal's Accessories tree, read on 2026-10-08, carries no end-of-sale notice for this part. The product page (SKU 71024) was live on 2026-10-08. No web search beyond FS's own pages was made.

method.note: the FS-CFS-1U datasheet (portal 1041; the shop-link revision has the same table and drawing) for the figures and the three-view drawing in inches and mm; the gallery renders of SKU 71024 for colour and the slots' look; the quick start guide V1.0 (portal 444, vector, read from its 300 dpi page render) for the hardware and the note on what the shelf may carry. FS publishes a Visio stencil (master FS-CFS-1U), which agrees.

mount-depth.note: cantilever: the shelf bolts to the FRONT rails only through its two ears (2 or 4 post racks) and nothing supports its rear; its depth is the tray's reach behind the front rails, not a rail-to-rail span.

qsg-note.note: the quick start guide's note: a device on the shelf should weigh under 10 kg and be under 10 in (254 mm) deep, and its own mounting ears need not be fixed to the rack. The product page adds that it holds only devices narrower than 440 mm.

sheet.note: `shell: sheet`, 1.2: the shelf is bent sheet steel and open air (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4); FS states the material and not its gauge. Its solid in 3D is the floor (a well on the top view, 42 deep in the 44 envelope - the deepest a sheet body builds, so the floor is drawn 2 thick where the sheet is about 1.2), the two side walls standing on it to their profile, and any rear lip; the six views are elevations.

references.title: FS FS-CFS-1U Quick Start Guide V1.0 (portal 444)
